x: And the final icing on the cake was an attack on the GB Club junior 4 x 100m relay record (41.32) by a Belgrave squad comprising of Wade Bennett-Jackson, Laurence Oboh, James Ellington and Set Osho.

U17 Set Osho demonstrated what a talent he is by winning the B in 48.8 seconds, faster than Ian Deeth's winning time in the A (49.3). Matt Douglas and Ryan Dinham showed total control in the lap hurdles and Matt's time was a Southern League record, beating the time set by Mark Bishop 13 years ago.
In the one-lap sprint Set Osho swept past the rest of the field along the back straight into a strong wind, and although feeling the effects in the home straight still clocked 51.2.
U17M. 100m 1r1 W.Bennett-Jackson 10.9w/2.8 (=meeting record). 200m: 1r1 W.Bennett-Jackson 22.0w/2.4; 1r2 S.Osho 23.2/1.7. 800m: 2r2 J.MacRae 2:10.5; 5r5 D.Stephens 2:31.2.

Set Osho, who had previously set a new pb of 47.58 (a European Junior qualifying time) in the A 400, reluctantly joined the long relay squad including the ubiquitous decathletes William and Kevin and 800 man Darren Gauson; they produced a creditable time of 3.20.30.

Men. 100m: 2rA H Aikines-Ayreetey U20 10.26w/3.6; 4rB L Oboh 10.87/2.0. 200m: 1rA W Bennett-Jackson U20 21.21w/2.1; 2rA J Ellington 21.53w/2.1; 2rB J Hussain U20 21.57/1.6; 6rB S Osho U20 21.92/1.6; 7rC G Selway U20 22.86w/3.3; 1rD R Thomas U20 22.08w/2.3. 110mH: 14.71w/2.8.

Set Osho, back from the European under 20 championships with a long relay gold medal, proved to all and sundry that his long awaited breakthrough has arrived as he set a new pb of 47.35sec which he followed later in the long relay with another sub 48sec clocking.

In the A 400 Set Osho continued to show improvement in a season which has only just started for him, while decathlete Louis Evling-Jones was another one who missed last season through injury but ran the field down on the home straight to snatch a fine second spot in the B 400.

Men. 100m: 2r1 H Aikines-Aryeetey U20 10.42/-0.5. 200m: 3r1 J Ellington 21.58/1.0; 1r2 J Hussain 21.89/0.0. 400m: 2r1 S Osho 47.81; 1r2 L Evling-Jones 48.02; 2r2 R Thomas U20 48.17. 800m: 2r1 G Oudney 1:48.67. 1500m: 11 K Gauson U20 3:56.53. 5000m: 8 P Wicks 14:36.02. 110mH: 2 D Girdler 13.91/1.1; 4…
The flat 400 proved no better as Newham gained second and first. In the A race it was clear that Set Osho still has a hamstring injury and we pulled him out of the long relay.
